correctness.rationale: The p/q telegraph equations reduce to p_tt+2γ0 p_t=v²[p_xx+2(γ1/v)(tanh(gx)p)_x]. With p=cosh(gx)^(−ν)ψ the spatial operator is Pöschl–Teller H=−∂²+a²−(a²+ag)sech²(gx), ν=γ1/(vg). Factorization Aν* Aν and Darboux intertwining give bound levels E_n=g²n(2ν−n) for integer 0≤n<ν, with continuum at a². Excluding stationary n=0 spurious mass-violating negative-time root, n≥1 has two physical roots; the smallest nonzero E is the n=1 level iff ν>1, otherwise the continuum threshold, proving the exact increasing-then-constant spectral gap. Parity alternation gives first even excitation at ν>2. Independent finite-difference Schrödinger computations checked four g values including plateau.
